messages:
emily: heads-up — did anyone else notice the office playlist just turned into an all-polka set? walked by the kitchen and it was like a 19th-century barn dance. :musical_note:

ryan: omg yes. was halfway through a standup call and suddenly accordions. who did this. :accordion: :sweat_smile:

spotify-bot: spotify:track-added by ryan — "Polka Party Mix 2020" added to Office Speakers. (auto-log)

nina: ryan?? explain. was this a revenge move for thermostat wars or are we embracing niche genres now? :thinking:

ryan: not me. I swear. I was muted and eating a sandwich. Might be the playlist gremlin.

jordyn: @ryan honor system: if you did it you must perform a 30-second polka solo in kitchen. If not, we need detective work. :mag:

sam: I nominate a mystery DJ spreadsheet. Columns: timestamp, culprit hypothesis, snack bribe, witness. I'll start.

zoe: vote: 1) keep for the day (mood boost) 2) revert to indie-electro 3) incremental polka (only 3 tracks) 4) full polka takeover (ryan dances)

emily: quick poll results so far — 1: zoe, 2: nina, 3: sam, 4: jordyn. Close race.

ryan: can we at least get a tiebreaker by lunchtime? I don't want to be the office pariah.

spotify-bot: manual-override available to admins. use /spotify revert or /spotify history to see last 20 adds.

nina: also petty but functional: someone left a sticky note on the speaker that says "Be kind. No surprise polkas after 2pm." Whoever wrote that deserves a cookie.

jordyn: I found a suspicious crumb trail leading from the speaker to the marketing table. Not naming names. :eyes:

emily: ok plan: @sam will build the mystery DJ spreadsheet, @zoe will host a 3pm "polka or not" vote, and @ryan will bring emergency earplugs just in case.

sam: spreadsheet is live: tinyurl.com/redwood-dj-detective (use responsibly).

zoe: if polka wins, we add it to Friday playlist rotation. if not, culprit buys cookies. stakes established.

emily: deal. may the best genre win. :tada:
